senses.gloss:
Tūpara, ‘hornless,’ is a frequent description of animals intended for the sacrifice, especially of the goat, in the Atharvaveda and later.
Foot notes Av. xi. 9, 22; taittirīya Saṃhitā, ii. 1, 1, 4, etc.; Vājasaneyi Saṃhitā, xxiv. 1, 15; xxix. 59, etc.; Satapatha brāhmaṇa, v. 1, 3, 7, etc.
